column7: SUPERFAN-1022 note 1 (ATOMIC-OWED-1): in the collect-only fallback (the pending record could not be written in the revocation's transaction) a refused owed row, and every later row of the same transaction (not attempted after the first refusal), was logged "NOT queued" and lost although the revocation committed. writeOwedAudit and noteOwedAuditNotAttempted now record such rows as pending after the commit (queueOwedAuditLate). The test refuses CreatePendingAuditEvent once plus every audit append on a two-row RemoveProjectMember, asserts both rows are pending, then backfills them from a fresh core on the same database (SQLite and PostgreSQL). Red on main 7e670da83: 0 of 2 rows queued.
